scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build:popup && npm run copy:static
scripts.copy:static: shx mkdir -p dist/popup dist/icons && shx cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && shx cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup/popup.html && shx cp src/popup/popup.css dist/popup/popup.css && shx cp -r icons/. dist/icons
